newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Oct first 10 days trade surplus down 14.1%.
newsitem.headline: Japan Oct first 10 days trade surplus down 14.1%.

text.p: Japan's customs-cleared trade surplus for the first 10 days of October was 142.69 billion yen, down 14.1 percent from a revised surplus of 166.10 billion yen in the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry announced on Thursday.
The figures were not adjusted for seasonal factors.
Japan had a trade surplus of 98.85 billion yen in the first 10 days of September.
Exports on a free-on-board (FOB) basis rose 21.9 percent from a year earlier to 1.27 trillion yen, while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports rose 28.7 percent to 1.13 trillion yen.
